title: Great
body:
I love it. Very customisable, the widgets make it easy to use. 

A tiny thing: Sometimes I’m a bit overwhelmed with all the options and the correlations are a bit confusing for me.

One big thing:
I’d love more detailed cycle tracking, specifically to find correlations between illness symptoms and/or meds and the cycle phases I’m in (I.e. luteal, ovulation, follicular, menstrual)
author: Ichmagaber

title: The best!
body: I love this app, I have tried many, but this one ist really great and so helpful.
